arxiv-2102-00487.title: Nonlinear Evolutionary PDE-Based Refinement of Optical Flow
arxiv-2102-00487.creator: Hirak Doshi, N. Uday Kiran
arxiv-2102-00487.description: Abstract The goal of this paper is to propose two nonlinear variational models for obtaining a refined motion estimation from an image sequence. Both the proposed models can be considered as a part of a generalized framework for an accurate estimation of physics-based flow fields such as rotational and fluid flow.

arxiv-2203-08588.title: MIMO-GAN: Generative MIMO Channel Modeling Qualcomm AI Research is an initiative of Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
arxiv-2203-08588.creator: Tribhuvanesh Orekondy 1 , Arash Behboodi 1 , Joseph B. Soriaga 2
arxiv-2203-08588.description: Abstract We propose generative channel modeling to learn statistical channel models from channel input-output measurements. Generative channel models can learn more complicated distributions and represent the field data more faithfully. They are tractable and easy to sample from, which can potentially speed up the simulation rounds.

arxiv-2205-09383.title: Emergent Visual Sensors for Autonomous Vehicles
arxiv-2205-09383.creator: You Li, Julien Moreau, Javier Ibanez-Guzman
arxiv-2205-09383.description: Abstract Autonomous vehicles rely on perception systems to understand their surroundings for further navigation missions. Cameras are essential for perception systems due to the advantages of object detection and recognition provided by modern computer vision algorithms, comparing to other sensors, such as LiDARs and radars.

arxiv-2206-03904.title: Constraints to neutron-star kicks in High-Mass X-ray Binaries with G aia EDR3
arxiv-2206-03904.creator: Francis Fortin, Federico García, Sylvain Chaty, Eric Chassande-Mottin, Adolfo Simaz Bunzel
arxiv-2206-03904.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Francis Fortin, Federico García, Sylvain Chaty, Eric Chassande-Mottin, Adolfo Simaz Bunzel. All neutron star progenitors in neutron-star High-Mass X-ray Binaries (NS HMXBs) undergo a supernova event that may lead to a significant natal kick impacting the motion of the whole binary system. The space observatory Gaia performs a deep optical survey with exquisite astrometric accuracy, for both position and proper motions, that can be used to study natal kicks in NS HMXBs.

arxiv-2304-00915.title: Anti-windup Coordination Strategy Around a Fair Equilibrium in Resource Sharing Networks
arxiv-2304-00915.creator: Felix Agner, Pauline Kergus, Anders Rantzer, Sophie Tarbouriech, Luca Zaccarian
arxiv-2304-00915.description: Abstract We coordinate interconnected agents where the control input of each agent is limited by the control input of others. In that sense, the systems have to share a limited resource over a network. Such problems can arise in different areas and it is here motivated by a district heating example.

arxiv-2304-08313.title: POD-ROMs for incompressible flows including snapshots of the temporal derivative of the full order solution: Error bounds for the pressure
arxiv-2304-08313.creator: Bosco García-Archilla, Volker John, Sarah Katz, Julia Novo
arxiv-2304-08313.description: Abstract Reduced order methods (ROMs) for the incompressible Navier–Stokes equations, based on proper orthogonal decomposition (POD), are studied that include snapshots which approach the temporal derivative of the velocity from a full order mixed finite element method (FOM). In addition, the set of snapshots contains the mean velocity of the FOM.

arxiv-2402-10487.title: RPMixer: Shaking Up Time Series Forecasting with Random Projections for Large Spatial-Temporal Data Conference: Proceedings of the 30th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining; August 25–29, 2024; Barcelona, Spain Proceedings of the 30th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discov
arxiv-2402-10487.creator: Chin-Chia Michael Yeh, Yujie Fan, Xin Dai, Uday Singh Saini, Vivian Lai, Prince Osei Aboagye, Junpeng Wang, Huiyuan Chen, Yan Zheng, Zhongfang Zhuang, Liang Wang, Wei Zhang
arxiv-2402-10487.description: Abstract . Spatial-temporal forecasting systems play a crucial role in addressing numerous real-world challenges. In this paper, we investigate the potential of addressing spatial-temporal forecasting problems using general time series forecasting models, i.e., models that do not leverage the spatial relationships among the nodes. We propose a all-Multi-Layer Perceptron (all-MLP) time series forecasting architecture called RPMixer.

arxiv-2410-23372.description: Abstract We exploit the VST ATLAS quasar/QSO catalogue to perform three measurements of the quasar halo mass profile. First, we make a new estimate of the angular auto-correlation function of ≈ 230,000 \approx 230,000 ATLAS quasars with z p ​ h ​ o ​ t ​ o ≲ 2.5 z_{photo}\lesssim 2.5 and 17 < g < 22 17<g<22 .

arxiv-2504-00456.title: Anisotropic mesh spacing prediction using neural networks
arxiv-2504-00456.creator: Callum Lock, Oubay Hassan, Ruben Sevilla, Jason Jones
arxiv-2504-00456.description: Abstract This work presents a framework to predict near-optimal anisotropic spacing functions suitable to perform simulations with unseen operating conditions or geometric configurations. The strategy consists of utilising the vast amount of high fidelity data available in industry to compute a target anisotropic spacing and train an artificial neural network to predict the spacing for unseen scenarios.

arxiv-2505-08790.title: Emergent dynamical phases and collective motion in termites
arxiv-2505-08790.creator: Leticia R. Paiva, Sidiney G. Alves, Og DeSouza, Octavio Miramontes
arxiv-2505-08790.description: Abstract Termites which are able to forage in the open can be often seen, in the field or in the lab: (i) wandering around, forming no observable pattern, or (ii) clustering themselves in a dense and almost immobile pack, or (iii) milling about in a circular movement.

britannica-1911-lewis-sir-george-cornewa.title: Lewis, Sir George Cornewall (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-lewis-sir-george-cornewa.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-lewis-sir-george-cornewa.description: Article 'Lewis, Sir George Cornewall' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 16), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. English statesman and man of letters, was born in London on the 21st of April 1806. His father, Thomas F. Lewis, of Harpton Court, Radnorshire, after holding subordinate office in various administrations, became a poor-law commissioner, and was made a baronet in 1846. Young Lewis was educated at Eton and at Christ Church, Oxford, where in 1828 he took a first-class in classics and a second-class in mathematics.

pmc-11381902.title: Does liquid nitrogen recycled autograft for treatment of bone sarcoma impact local recurrence rate? A systematic review
pmc-11381902.creator: Ana Cecilia Belzarena, James L Cook
pmc-11381902.description: Highlights•Surgical resection with wide margins has been gold standard treatment for bone sarcomas.•Recycling resected bone with liquid nitrogen offers various advantages but has limited acceptance due to concerns about local recurrence.•A systematic review of literature from 2008 to 2023 identified 16 studies involving 286 patients with primary bone sarcoma treate.369d with liquid nitrogen recycled autografts.•Local recurrence occurred in 8.

pmc-11507050.title: The Effect of Fatty Acids Profile in Potato and Corn Chips on Consumer Preferences
pmc-11507050.creator: Okan Gaytancıoğlu, Fuat Yılmaz, Ümit Geçgel, Raquel P F Guiné
pmc-11507050.description: The global market for potato and corn chips is rapidly expanding due to the modern fast-paced lifestyle. However, the high fat content, especially saturated fats in these deep-fried snacks, poses significant health risks such as hypertension, coronary heart disease, and diabetes.

pmc-11517158.title: 1.M. Scientific session: Young and lonely – exploring experiences, challenges, and potential solutions
pmc-11517158.creator: Organised by: Defactum (Denmark)Chair persons: Julie Christiansen (Denmark), Anne Friis Bo (Denmark)
pmc-11517158.description: Experiencing loneliness is a natural facet of human existence, often considered a normative aspect of adolescent life. However, for some adolescents, this experience evolves into a ‘vicious circle’ of prolonged loneliness, making it challenging to reconnect with their social environment. This issue is important given the significance of fulfilling social relationships during adolescence.

pmc-11679528.title: A Novel MZI Fiber Sensor with Enhanced Curvature and Strain Sensitivity Based on Four-Core Fiber
pmc-11679528.creator: Xiaojun Zhu, Feijie Chen, Haoran Zhuang, Jiayi Qian, Hai Liu, Juan Cao, Yuechun Shi, Xia Wang, Wuming Wu, Muhammad Ali Butt
pmc-11679528.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). We present a high-sensitivity curvature and strain Mach–Zehnder interferometer (MZI) fiber sensor based on a configuration of no-core fiber (NCF) and four-core fiber (FCF). We used an optical fiber fusion splicer to directly splice a segment of FCF between two segments of NCF, with both the FCF and NCF made of SiO2, where the FCF exhibits multi-path interference characteristics that allow for higher sensitivity.

pmc-12397559.title: Autophagy Protease ATG4D Facilitates Proliferation and Malignancy of Osteosarcoma Cells
pmc-12397559.creator: Pei‐Feng Liu, Shan‐Wei Yang, Wen‐Hsin Yang, Shu‐Fang Huang, Ching‐Yang Tsai, Chien‐Jen Hsu, Ho‐Hsing Tseng, Cheng‐Hsin Lee, Chih‐Wen Shu
pmc-12397559.description: Osteosarcoma is one of the most prevalent malignant tumors in pediatric cancer, with survival rates remaining stagnant for over a decade, particularly among patients with metastatic disease. Thus, identifying novel therapeutic targets is critical for improving clinical outcomes. The ATG4 family (ATG4A, ATG4B, ATG4C, and ATG4D) encodes proteases essential for autophagy, a process implicated in cancer progression and drug resistance.

pmc-12441005.title: How Neurologists Combine Clinical Signs and Subjective Factors to Diagnose Epileptic and Functional Seizures: Insights From Seizure Video Analysis
pmc-12441005.creator: Subramanian Muthusamy, Udaya Seneviratne, Henry Ma, Thanh G Phan
pmc-12441005.description: BackgroundEvaluating seizure semiology is crucial for distinguishing functional seizures (FS) from epileptic seizures (ES). This study examines how neurologists integrate clinical signs, observations, and subjective factors in making this distinction.MethodsNeurologists at Monash Health assessed unlabeled seizure videos on a web‐based platform, providing free‐text descriptions, selecting observed clinical signs, offering diagnoses, and rating their certainty (0–100).

pmc-12451945.title: Genome-wide identification of the OVATE gene family of proteins in soybean and expression profiling under salt stress
pmc-12451945.creator: Fan Zhan, Yi Wang, Lili Zhang, Yuehua Yu, Zhiyong Ni
pmc-12451945.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). OVATE family proteins (OFPs), a class of plant-specific transcription factors, have been increasingly demonstrated to play pivotal roles in multiple aspects of plant growth and development. However, their functional characterization in soybean (Glycine max) remains largely unexplored.

pmc-12609285.title: Functional and Vascular Outcomes of Posterior Acetabular Wall Osteosynthesis via the Kocher–Langenbeck Approach: A Dynamic Analysis
pmc-12609285.creator: Yuriy Prudnikov, Nicholas David Clement
pmc-12609285.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: The Kocher–Langenbeck approach is widely used for surgical fixation of posterior acetabular wall fractures. While previous studies have focused on mechanical outcomes and the risk of post-traumatic osteoarthritis, the effects on peripheral circulation and neuromuscular recovery remain underexplored. This study aimed to evaluate dynamic changes in neuromuscular function and microcirculation following open reduction and internal fixation (ORIF) using this approach. Methods: A retrospective analysis was conducted on 34 patients (aged 23–75) treated for posterior acetabular wall fractures between 2014 and 2022.

pmc-13640391.title: Non-contact sexual violence and its association with sexual & psychosocial health in Iranian women: a national cross-sectional study
pmc-13640391.creator: Elnaz Khayer, Rezvan Zarei, Beáta Bőthe, Farnaz Farnam
pmc-13640391.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundNon-contact sexual violence (NCSV) and its trauma remain understudied, limiting prevention and legal protection. This national study examined NCSV patterns and compared sexual, psychological, and social health among women with and without NCSV experiences globally.MethodsA controlled cross-sectional study recruited 540 married women aged 18–76 years from all 31 provinces of Iran between November 2022 and June 2023 using online and in-person convenience sampling. Participants were categorized into NCSV + and NCSV− groups.
